profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cosairus
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, driven, and creative Computer Science Graduate with experience in C#, Java, ASP.Net, and Python. Currently seeking a development position to learn, collaborate and excel in today's growing technology industry.

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Troubleshooted computer hardware and software issues
•	Configured computer hardware to communicate with laboratory test equipment
•	Created custom Excel templates with Microsoft Visual Basic to automate information reporting.
•	Managed SharePoint Site for information collaboration on projects.

positions.title: Computer Science Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Leader of Supplemental Instruction sessions.
•	Face to Face tutoring, related to programming concepts and assignments. 
•	Tele-tutoring for undergraduate and graduate level computer science courses.

projects.title: Capstone Project
projects.description: Developed a web application using ASP.Net MVC 6 and C#. The application is a functional clone of the popular mobile game Trivia Crack. This project made use of the Entity Framework, Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. The repository pattern was used to ensure the code remains maintainable for companies. This was a team project consisting of 3 members.
